metadata.author: Mariglen Tanushi
metadata.institution: Universita Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Milano

methodology.marginals: option-implied: raw-SVI per pillar (butterfly/calendar penalties), total-variance interpolation in T, Breeden-Litzenberger CDF, inverse CDF; flat-smile lognormal at ATM-forward vol as benchmark
methodology.spx_2y: extrapolated beyond the 1.38y pillar (flat ATM vol, fixed smile in standardised moneyness)
methodology.regime_snapshots: Cboe VIX close on snapshot date; calm<20<=elevated<30<=stress
methodology.regime_returns: previous trading day Cboe VIX close
methodology.euribor: latest monthly average complete on the snapshot date (ECB FM.M.U2.EUR.RT.MM.EURIBOR3MD_.HSTA)
